items.title: CME launches 23-hour single-stock futures to trade stocks like SpaceX, Micron
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses how CME (CME) has launched 23-hour single-stock futures for trading shares of SpaceX (SPCX), Micron Technology (MU), and other stocks. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto. Make sure to also check out Yahoo Finance's new crypto hub to find the latest crypto-related news.

items.title: Amazon tops Fortune Global 500 list, ending Walmart's 12-year reign
items.summary: Fortune editor-in-chief Alyson Shontell joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi on Opening Bid to discuss the 2025 Fortune Global 500, the annual ranking of the world's largest companies by revenue. This year, Amazon (AMZN) claimed the No. 1 spot, ending Walmart's (WMT) 12-year run at the top.
